provenance.usage_policy: known completed logical calls; unresolved provider attempt reservations remain in the cumulative gateway ledger
provenance.sampling_policy: identical prompts with provider defaults, no assumed diversity

dataset.name: texa-browser-regression-v1
dataset.purpose: Regression replay of real user questions submitted through the browser on 2026-11-06.

provenance.labels: Copied only from independent reference_sql and expected_columns/expected_rows in the immutable browser artifact.
provenance.note: These questions and labels were exposed during prior development; regression data only, not a fair sealed comparison set.

annotation_erratum.issue: Browser preflight failed because the copied JSON artifact encoded a Decimal conversion result as a string, while PostgreSQL returns this result as a numeric value.
annotation_erratum.field: buyer_conversion_rate for browser_single_cosmetics_conversion and dialogue turn 10
annotation_erratum.correction: Annotate 0.42857142857142857143 as a YAML numeric scalar so result comparison uses the declared numeric tolerance.
annotation_erratum.semantic_change: none; the annotated value is within the benchmark results_equal tolerance of the independent PostgreSQL reference result.
annotation_erratum.raw_source_artifact: unchanged; source_sha256 above continues to identify the original artifact.

dataset.fixture_policy: Exact copies of challenge_v1 fixture worlds; browser regression rows are not new production data.

input_policy.baseline: Physical PostgreSQL schema plus user-authored text and explicit UI scope only; no semantic metric definitions.
input_policy.texa: Same user turns, fixture and model; Texa may use its semantic catalog/workflow.
input_policy.source_conflict: Separate diagnostic; user-selected Cosmetics conflicts with text naming Olist, expected to clarify.
input_policy.scoring: Full independently authored SQL output tables; no QuerySpec, model trace, or internal state is a scoring oracle.

turns.sql:
SELECT SUM(e.revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s USING (source_id)
WHERE s.label = 'Cosmetics Shop';

SELECT SUM(e.revenue_usd) AS total_revenue_usd
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label ILIKE '%Olist%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS buyer_count
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label ILIKE '%Cosmetics Shop%'
  AND e.event_name = 'purchase';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_view_count
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label ILIKE '%Cosmetics Shop%'
  AND e.event_name = 'view_item';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS unique_product_viewers
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Cosmetics Shop'
  AND e.event_name = 'view_item';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS session_count
FROM analytics.event_activity e
JOIN analytics.source_registry s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Cosmetics Shop';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS unique_user_count
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Cosmetics Shop';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Cosmetics Shop';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.quantity), 0) AS purchased_product_lines
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label ILIKE '%Cosmetics Shop%'
  AND e.event_name IN ('purchase', 'purchase_item');

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'purchase')::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 0) AS buyer_to_observed_user_ratio
FROM analytics.event_activity
WHERE source_id IN (
  SELECT source_id
  FROM analytics.source_registry
  WHERE label = 'Cosmetics Shop'
);

SELECT date_trunc('month', event_date)::date AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM analytics.event_activity WHERE source_id IN (SELECT source_id FROM analytics.source_registry WHERE label ILIKE '%Cosmetics Shop%' OR description ILIKE '%Cosmetics Shop%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyer_count
FROM analytics.event_activity
WHERE source_id IN (SELECT source_id FROM analytics.source_registry WHERE label ILIKE '%Olist%')
  AND (event_name IN ('purchase', 'purchase_completed') OR revenue_usd > 0 OR revenue > 0);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS purchased_product_lines
FROM analytics.event_activity
WHERE source_id IN (SELECT source_id FROM analytics.source_registry WHERE label ILIKE '%Olist%')
  AND event_name = 'purchase';

SELECT ea.platform AS device, SUM(ea.revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM analytics.event_activity ea
JOIN analytics.source_registry sr ON sr.source_id = ea.source_id
WHERE sr.label ILIKE '%Cosmetics Shop%'
GROUP BY ea.platform
ORDER BY ea.platform

SELECT COALESCE(e.ep->>'campaign_channel', '(unknown)') AS campaign_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS buyer_count
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Cosmetics Shop'
  AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
GROUP BY COALESCE(e.ep->>'campaign_channel', '(unknown)')
ORDER BY campaign_channel;

SELECT date_trunc('month', event_date)::date AS month, SUM(revenue_usd) AS total_revenue_usd
FROM analytics.event_activity
WHERE source_id IN (SELECT source_id FROM analytics.source_registry WHERE label ILIKE '%Olist%')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

cost_basis: known token usage only; gateway ledger retains uncertain attempt reservations

turns.sql:
SELECT SUM(e.revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Cosmetics Shop'
  AND e.platform = 'mobile'
  AND e.ep->>'channel' = 'paid';

SELECT SUM(e.revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Cosmetics Shop'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(e.ep->>'channel', e.ep->>'traffic_medium')) = 'paid';

SELECT date_trunc('month', e.event_date)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS buyers
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Cosmetics Shop'
  AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
